items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Harrison was on trombone and then I think the guy from -- that used to be with the -- McKinney's Cotton Pickers

ctx.x: No. This is a nice-looking little stark fellow and he played pretty good. Can't think -- Harrison was on trombone and then I think the guy from -- that used to be with the -- McKinney's Cotton Pickers, what's his name. With the toupee, played trombone. Clyde something.
